diagnostics.message: :resource.aws_autoscaling_group.ng: explicit depends_on of :resource.aws_iam_role.ng is redundant — already implied by attribute references
:resource.aws_autoscaling_group.ng: explicit depends_on of :resource.aws_launch_template.ng is redundant — already implied by attribute references
:resource.aws_eks_node_group.ng: explicit depends_on of :resource.aws_iam_role.ng is redundant — already implied by attribute references

aws_autoscaling_group.ng already depends on aws_launch_template.ng through the attribute references launch_template_id = aws_launch_template.ng[each.key].id and version = aws_launch_template.ng[each.key].latest_version in its mixed_instances_policy; the explicit depends_on entry for aws_launch_template.ng duplicates that inferred dependency and can be removed.

aws_eks_node_group.ng already depends on aws_iam_role.ng via the attribute reference node_role_arn = aws_iam_role.ng.0.arn; the explicit depends_on entry for aws_iam_role.ng duplicates that inferred dependency and can be removed. (The policy-attachment entries in the same depends_on block are still needed and should be kept.)
